question: On ESP32 chip revision v0.0, repeated consecutive writes to the same DPORT register address sometimes get lost, both for UART2 FIFO and for GPIO_OUT1_W1TC. What workaround should I use?

content.text: Question: On ESP32 chip revision v0.0, repeated consecutive writes to the same DPORT register address sometimes get lost, both for UART2 FIFO and for GPIO_OUT1_W1TC. What workaround should I use?

generation.answer: For UART2 FIFO and GPIO_OUT1_W1TC on ESP32 chip revision v0.0, use the equivalent AHB address instead of the DPORT address when writing the same register address in sequential instructions. This will prevent data loss due to the peripheral being mapped to two internal memory buses (AHB & DPORT) [Page 1].
